text_block_list.text: While training off-campus together with Admire Groove—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's all for today's training...
Could you please head back ahead of me?

She starts walking off somewhere just like that.
What should I do?
choice_data_list: There's still more on the workout routine, though...

text_block_list.name: Fluffy Dog
text_block_list.text: Grrrrrr...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought...
There's fishing line tangled around its leg.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Calm down.
I won't do you any harm.

text_block_list.name: Fluffy Dog
text_block_list.text: ...Whimper...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, good girl.

text_block_list.name: Dog Owner Lady
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Maruru...!
I'll make sure the leash doesn't come off...!

text_block_list.name: Dog Owner Lady
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, young lady.
Thanks to you, this child wasn't injured either...
Would you please allow me to thank you properly?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm not asking for anything in return.
...It's just.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: If you could just keep a close eye on that girl...

text_block_list.name: Dog Owner Lady
text_block_list.text:
That's true... Of course! I'm really...
so glad a girl who loves dogs was here to help!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I like it or anything... No.
Farewell, then.

Afterward—when I met up with Admire Groove again,
she had a noticeably brighter, refreshed look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Fluffy Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof! Woof!

text_block_list.name: Dog Owner Lady
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* Maruruuu...!
Go a little sloweeer...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Just as I thought.
That's the little one who got caught in the fishing line before—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Wagging your tail like that.
You remembered me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Dog Owner Lady
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, you! The young lady who helped Maruru before!

text_block_list.name: Dog Owner Lady
text_block_list.text: Fufu, so that's why you suddenly dashed off.

text_block_list.name: Maruru
text_block_list.text: *whine*, *whimper* ♪

text_block_list.name: Dog Owner Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. I was meaning to give this to you when we met.
Here, if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
A dog keychain...
It looks just like this one.

text_block_list.name: Maruru
text_block_list.text: Bow-wow! Heh-heh-heh...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey... don't lick me.

text_block_list.name: Dog Owner Lady
text_block_list.text: Looks like Maruru has completely fallen in love with youâª

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...*ahem*
Thank you for the keychain.
Now, if you will excuse me.

Afterward—when I met up with Admire Groove again,
she seemed somewhat restless.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I'll make up for it later with voluntary training.

No sooner had she said it than she hurried away.
Just as she said, I decided to head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll make up for that through self-training.
I won't cause any trouble."

Knowing her, she'll follow through on her word.
I decided to obediently head back to the academy.
